turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a meteor shower Saturday night and I really want to photograph it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great plan. Would you drive out somewhere properly dark, maybe two hours away, or try from your back garden and see what you get?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Emma something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did the plumber call you back?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: He did. He can come Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thursday? The sink's been leaking since Sunday.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I know. He said everyone's pipes are freezing this week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did he say how much it would be?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not really. Just that it depends what he finds.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great, very reassuring. Can you put a bucket under it in the meantime?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. The meteor shower on Saturday. Driving out, or staying in the garden?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll drive out. If I'm doing it, I want it done right.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then pack a tripod, a warm coat and a red torch, and check the cloud forecast before you leave.
